name: Anthem / global pump toolkit
name_zh: 赞美诗（全局增益）主题工具箱

statuses.consider: 备用组件；不会自动进入牌表。
statuses.seed: 只有在显式复制到构筑种子后才作为必留牌。
statuses.candidate: 可供构筑器评分，但仍需人工确认。
statuses.retired: 历史记录；不应进入新的候选池。

selection_policy.builder_contract: 构筑器只消费显式传入的种子或候选池；未选条目始终只作备查。

validation.source: Scryfall cached card data (exact set/collector lookup)

source_queries: f:pioneer game:arena o:"creatures you control get"
f:pioneer game:arena o:"other creatures you control get"
f:pioneer game:arena o:"creatures you control of the chosen type"
set/collector exact checks for manually screened anthem support
review_notes: Entries cover static anthems, chosen-type lords, token/counter engines, and conditional team pumps.
This review adds 15 later-set entries through HOB; narrow tribal lords remain reference-only unless the build supplies their creature type.
A card is not an anthem solely because it is powerful; each entry has a documented board-density or timing constraint.
Recheck legality, Arena printings, wording, and token/counter rules after every series or rules/card-face change.

update_policy: Update this toolkit after every series, supplemental product, or card-face/rules change before selecting cards for a build.

support_cards.name: Rally the Ranks
support_cards.note: Two-mana +1/+1 for the named creature type; needs a dense tribe.

support_cards.name: Radiant Destiny
support_cards.note: Adds vigilance after ascend; token count and permanent density matter.

support_cards.name: Icon of Ancestry
support_cards.note: Provides +1/+1 and late-game creature selection for one named type.

support_cards.name: Vanquisher's Banner
support_cards.note: Five-mana payoff that draws on creature casts of the named type.

support_cards.name: Adaptive Automaton
support_cards.note: Colorless creature lord; it also becomes the chosen type and is vulnerable as a creature.

support_cards.name: Banner of Kinship
support_cards.note: Scales with the number of creatures already in play; weak when played before a board develops.

support_cards.name: Always Watching
support_cards.note: Gives nontoken creatures +1/+1 and vigilance; it does not buff creature tokens.

support_cards.name: Benalish Marshal
support_cards.note: Efficient +1/+1 lord, but the triple-white cost constrains mana.

support_cards.name: Heraldic Banner
support_cards.note: Names a color for +1/+0 and also produces that color; weaker in multicolor boards.

support_cards.name: The Immortal Sun
support_cards.note: Six-mana +1/+1 with draw and cost reduction; shuts off all planeswalker loyalty abilities.

support_cards.name: Weaver of Harmony
support_cards.note: Buffs other enchantment creatures and can copy an enchantment ability; requires the right permanent mix.

support_cards.name: Angel of Invention
support_cards.note: Fabricate offers a wide board or a large body, while other creatures get +1/+1.

support_cards.name: Felidar Retreat
support_cards.note: Landfall chooses a Cat token or team counters/vigilance; needs reliable land drops.

support_cards.name: Anointed Procession
support_cards.note: Doubles tokens rather than buffing creatures; only belongs in a token-producing shell.

support_cards.name: Trial of Solidarity
support_cards.note: Enters with +2/+1 and vigilance; Cartouche support can replay it.

support_cards.name: The Great Henge
support_cards.note: Discounted by a large creature and then adds counters, mana, life, and cards; not a standalone early anthem.

support_cards.name: Patchwork Banner
support_cards.note: Names a creature type, grants +1/+1, and taps for any color.

support_cards.name: An Unexpected Party // At the Door
support_cards.note: Enchantment face grants +2/+2 to the chosen type; Adventure face creates Dwarf tokens first.

support_cards.name: Door of Destinies
support_cards.note: Grows from casting the named type; slow without enough tribal spell density.

support_cards.name: Chronicle of Victory
support_cards.note: Grants +2/+2, first strike, trample, and draws on chosen-type spells.

support_cards.name: Kinbinding
support_cards.note: Scales with creatures entering this turn and creates a Kithkin token each combat.

support_cards.name: Elvish Archdruid
support_cards.note: Elf-only +1/+1 plus scalable green mana; requires a dense Elf shell.

support_cards.name: Dwynen, Gilt-Leaf Daen
support_cards.note: Elf-only +1/+1 with an attack-based life payoff; type-specific.

support_cards.name: Glacier Godmaw
support_cards.note: Landfall grants +1/+1, vigilance, and haste to the team; six-mana finisher.

support_cards.name: Lumen-Class Frigate
support_cards.note: At two charge counters, other creatures get +1/+1; requires a Spacecraft station plan.

support_cards.name: Comforting Counsel
support_cards.note: Reaches +3/+3 after five life-gain counters; slow and shell-dependent.

support_cards.name: Fíli the Pathfinder
support_cards.note: After storied, grants +1/+1 and makes Dwarf tokens from nontoken Dwarves.

support_cards.name: The Arkenstone // Seek the Heart
support_cards.note: Artifact face grants +1/+1 and end-step draw; Adventure finds a legendary creature.

support_cards.name: Suki, Courageous Rescuer
support_cards.note: Other creatures get +1/+0 while permanent-leave events create Ally tokens.

support_cards.name: Invasion Tactics
support_cards.note: Enters with a team +2/+2 burst and draws from Ally combat damage.

support_cards.name: Leyline of Hope
support_cards.note: Can start in play and reaches +2/+2 after a seven-life advantage; needs a lifegain shell.

selection.mtga_import_semantics: One copy of every reference entry for direct MTGA import; this is an inventory preview, not a final deck or mandatory seed.
selection.rule: The builder may select a subset of toolkit entries; unselected entries remain reference-only.
